sources.title: Curvature-induced bound states in Robin waveguides and their asymptotical properties
sources.version_status: arXiv:1406.7624v1, 30 June 2014; J. Math. Phys. 55 (2014), 122101. Metadata observation recorded 10 October 2026.
sources.source_role_and_hypotheses: Credited planar nontrivial same-line C4 compact perturbation theorem. Section 5, Theorem 5.1 establishes the threshold; Theorem 5.2 proves all-coupling binding. Concave-wedge nonbinding has different asymptotics.
sources.recorded_inspection: One-based PDF pages 16, 17 and 20 visually inspected; Section 5 assumptions and Theorems 5.1 and 5.2.

sources.title: An effective Hamiltonian for the eigenvalue asymptotics of a Robin Laplacian with a large parameter
sources.version_status: Retained arXiv:1502.00877v2, 28 April 2015; recorded arXiv comment remains Preliminary version. J. Math. Pures Appl. 106 (2016), 615–650. Metadata observation recorded 10 October 2026.
sources.source_role_and_hypotheses: Corollary 1.6 is a sufficiently-large-coupling result under its admissibility/curvature hypotheses. It does not give all-coupling binding and is compatible with weak-coupling absence.
sources.recorded_inspection: One-based PDF page 4, Corollary 1.6, visually inspected.

sources.title: On the bound state induced by δ-interaction on a weakly deformed plane
sources.version_status: Aspect17, Trier, 28 September 2017; talk slides, not a proved Robin theorem.
sources.source_role_and_hypotheses: Printed slide 9 uses beta for deformation amplitude and fixes delta-interaction coupling alpha. Printed slide 15 records higher-dimensional delta-interaction and Robin expectations; the Robin block does not restate dimension. The delta expectation is not relabeled as a Robin theorem. Historical context only.
sources.recorded_inspection: PDF has 14 pages with skipped printed slide numbers. One-based PDF page 12, printed slide 15, was visually inspected from a local rendering after the web screenshot route failed with a cache miss.

bounded_search_scope: Recorded searches combined Robin Laplacian, locally deformed or perturbed half-space, compact graph, bound states, weak coupling, and higher dimensions. They found the cited literature and the 2017 talk; they did not certify prior publication of the full n=3 nongraph or n>=4 weak-coupling graph statements. Bounded search does not prove novelty.
